description: Render one data-bound chart from rows or a structured data operand. Use it when creating chart output; use artifact_certify instead to grade a normalized chart or dashboard_render for multiple panels and KPIs. Returns Vega-Lite or ECharts specs, chart identities and requested SVG/accessibility output. pattern uses bundled data and forbids explicit data/encoding/presentation overrides. Otherwise use chartType plus encodings, omit chartType for recommendations, or supply structured intent. ECharts-primary families require their matching hierarchy/network/geo operand. brand/theme controls pixels; output.includeNormalizedSpec returns the IR required by artifact_certify. Temporal rendering uses UTC. For native ECharts after JSON transport, restore currency and precision with @oods/foundry/echarts.js. Charts take inline data only; URLs, images and links in the input are refused. Full schema: oods://schemas/viz_render.input.json.

a11yEquivalence.description: Check Vega-Lite accessible equivalents (default true). Errors stop rendering; warnings are returned. ECharts-primary scaffolds are not checked here.

brand.description: CSS token brand for chart pixels. Omission resolves light/A.

chartType.description: Chart family for explicit mode. Cartesian charts need rows/datasetRef and encodings; other families need their named data input. Omit to suggest from rows.

chord.description: Chord input: {nodes:[{name}],links:[{source,target,value}]}; links refer to node names; each directed pair must be unique.

datasetRef.description: Previously cached dataset id; alternative to rows.

description.description: Optional override for the synthesized accessibility description. When omitted, a non-empty description is generated from the encodings.

encodings.description: Cartesian bindings: each needs field; optional type, aggregate, title, format (d3-format), currency (ISO 4217).

geo.description: Inline geojson or topojson plus topoObjectName, rows, join, valueField; optional point/flow coordinate fields. No network fetch. Re-register echartsSpec.__registration before rendering. Read full schema.

id.description: Optional stable identifier for the produced spec.

intent.description: Structured request: goal, measures:[{name}], dimensions:[{name}], optional chartFamily and measureRef. Uses rows or datasetRef; alternative to explicit chartType/encodings.

network.description: Force graph input: {nodes:[{id,group}],links:[{source,target,value}]}; max 250 nodes. Use chartType:"force_graph". Full contract: oods://schemas/viz_render.input.json.

opacity.description: Constant mark opacity for Cartesian charts only; omission keeps renderer defaults.

output.description: Options: svg, width, height, compact, echarts, includeNormalizedSpec, includeA11y, includeVegaSpec, titlePlacement (chart or figure). SVG is opt-in; compact defaults true.

pattern.description: Exact registered pattern identity; preserves source data and presentation. Cannot combine with chartType, data, intent or identity/presentation overrides.

rows.description: Inline flat data rows. Use either rows or datasetRef.

sankey.description: Sankey input: {nodes:[{name}],links:[{source,target,value}]}; links refer to node names. Use chartType:"sankey".

strictFields.description: Warn about unresolved fields and unmatched map joins (OODS-V131/V134). Default false preserves existing behavior.

theme.description: Chart token theme. HC preserves system colors and needs a forced-colors browser to resolve them.

name: viz_render
title: Render Chart
